headline: Nigeria North-East Commission launches program to support 10,330 EVs
summary: The North East Development Commission initiated stakeholder training and awareness to support the deployment of 10,330 electric vehicles amid rising transport costs.
why: Nigeria's regional development agencies are investing in electric mobility to mitigate elevated domestic fuel prices.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: EV deployment lowers commercial transport fuel overheads over time.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
